result.verdict: DOCUMENTED: the Kashaev deformed fluctuation tower does NOT reproduce the b-tower phase law κ̃_n=ρ_n·ωⁿ term-by-term — arg(κ_n^Kashaev) is tiny and positive (~+0.0003→+0.012), not the b-tower's −n·arctan(t/π). The two towers relate by RESUMMATION (ħ↔2πi/N), so this DISTINCT route cannot term-by-term confirm #3923's 4₁ odd-phase null — the wall is load-bearing, a category-error guard for the campaign (b-tower amplitudes r̃ and Kashaev-frame numbers are not interchangeable). It DOES agree qualitatively: the Kashaev per-rung phase stays below the kinematic magnitude, so both frames see only weak odd phase in the deformed 4₁ tower. The 4₁ lane remains #3923's (complete); the open frontier is the non-amphichiral 5₂-class lane (#3892/#3902). scope-(a): documentation of the two-tower distinction + qualitative cross-frame consistency, NOT a term-by-term confirmation. μ never fixed from QOU data.
